ai.title: AI features
ai.description: Switch AI features on or off and stop all AI at once. Suggestions never change records by themselves.

killSwitch.title: Global kill switch
killSwitch.activeBody: The global kill switch is active: every AI feature refuses requests until it is cleared.
killSwitch.inactiveBody: The global kill switch is off. Each feature follows its own toggle.
killSwitch.unknownBody: The kill switch state is shown once a feature state has loaded.
killSwitch.confirmActivateBody: Every AI feature will refuse requests immediately. Staff keep working without suggestions.
killSwitch.confirmClearBody: Features whose own toggle is on will answer again.
killSwitch.failed: The kill switch could not be changed.
